hints.title: Track Consecutive Run Length
hints.text: Iterate through string s maintaining the count of consecutive equal characters.

hints.title: Reset on Character Change
hints.text: When s[i] equals s[i - 1], increment current run length. Otherwise reset run length to 1.

hints.title: Maximize Run Length
hints.text: Update the global maximum run length at each position and return it.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Rechecking substrings repeatedly creates quadratic overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single linear scan tracks runs in constant space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate tracks run length with one pass and updates max count.
complexity.notes: Minimum power is 1 for non-empty string.
